title: Ai2 open-sources AstaBrief for faster cited research reports
friendlyTitle: A smaller open model writes cited research reports
summary: Ai2 released AstaBrief 8B, an open-weights model that turns research questions and retrieved literature into cited reports. Built from Qwen3-8B, it powers Asta’s Fast mode and is released with training data and an example workflow for reports from local PDFs.
friendlySummary: AstaBrief 8B can turn a question and research papers into a report with citations. Ai2 has shared the model, training data and a workflow for using your own PDF files.
whyItMatters: The release offers researchers a smaller model they can run on their own infrastructure when questions or source documents are sensitive. Ai2 reports a 51.1-second average for Fast mode versus 178.5 seconds for its Claude-powered Thinking mode, while noting that its comparisons reflect the models available during evaluation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Researchers can make reports faster and keep sensitive work on their own computers or servers. The citations also make the result easier to check.
